about: Labels changed by hand, each with the library source that shows it (bench/holdout/README.md: call breaks found by binding are checked against the source at `to`). A use overridden here is excluded.

overrides.probe: breaks (param_removed): the model's generated signature names the field by its alias, `max_completion_tokens`
overrides.why: at 1.7.4 AzureChatOpenAI declares `max_tokens: int | None = Field(default=None, alias="max_completion_tokens")` and BaseChatOpenAI sets `populate_by_name=True`, so `max_tokens=` still sets the field
overrides.evidence: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/blob/langchain-openai%3D%3D1.7.4/libs/partners/openai/langchain_openai/chat_models/azure.py (max_tokens field, alias max_completion_tokens) and chat_models/base.py (model_config = ConfigDict(populate_by_name=True))

overrides.probe: breaks (param_not_yet_added): the model's generated signature has no `cache`
overrides.why: at 0.1.32 Agent is a pydantic model whose model_config sets only arbitrary_types_allowed (pydantic's default extra="ignore"), and its validators run after construction, so an unknown keyword is accepted and dropped, not an error

overrides.probe: breaks (param_not_yet_added): the model's generated signature has no `expected_output`
overrides.why: at 0.1.32 Task is a pydantic model with no model_config (default extra="ignore") and only an after-validator, so an unknown keyword is accepted and dropped

at 1.67.0 `html` is deprecate_func_name(streamlit._main._html, ...), a functools.wraps wrapper that calls the bound method `_main._html(html, width, height, ...)` with the caller's arguments, so one positional argument is the HTML; inspect.signature follows __wrapped__ through the bound method to the plain function and counts `self`
